extracted.name: Zucchini Bread
extracted.description: Yep! It is a fall classic in our household. Crispy, buttery deliciousness waiting after a yummy oxtail dinner!
instruction_lines: Grate zucchini and mix ingredients in bowl.
Grease and flour two bread baking pans. Pour mixture in pans.
Add to oven bake for 50 mins. Or until done in center.
With a lil sweet cream butter, ENJOY friends!
